blocks.text: Non-polar ya be-charge molecules pani mein hal nahin hote, kyun ke pani ke molecules un se hydrogen bonds nahin banate. Jab inhein pani mein dala jata hai to pani ke molecules inhein bahar dhakel dete hain. Yeh na-hal hone wale molecules aapas mein hydrophobic jor (associations) bana lete hain. Maslan lipid molecules pani mein hal nahin hote; pani se bahar dhakele jane par yeh aapas mein mazbooti se jur jate hain. Isi liye lipids cells ki membranes qaim rakhne mein madad karte hain (Figure 4.9: pani mein tel ki boondein pani se alag aapas mein jur jati hain).

blocks.alt: Tel aur pani, kitab ki tasveer ke mutabiq: upar tel ki peeli teh jis mein gol boondein hain; neeche halka pani jis mein tel ki mukhtalif size ki gol peeli boondein aur juri hui boondon ki ek bal khati lakeer hai. Tel boondon ki shakal mein ikattha rehta hai aur pani mein nahin milta.
